title: A Prayer for Healing
summary: Since ancient times people have prayed to the sun, moon, earth, wind, water, plants and animals because they knew how important nature is. The earth is our only home, but we have not taken good care of it. 'A Prayer for Healing' is an appeal to all people around the globe to make a collective effort to heal the earth and renew all life.
Each stanza begins with the refrain 'We join with the earth and with each other' — we unite with nature and with all people.

Stanza 1: to bring new life to the land, restore the waters and refresh the air (clean the polluted land, water and air). Stanza 2: to renew the forests, care for the plants and protect the creatures (stop cutting trees, protect plants and animals). Stanza 3: to celebrate the seas, rejoice in the sunlight and sing the song of the stars (enjoy and be grateful for nature's gifts). Stanza 4: to recreate the human community, promote justice and peace and remember our children (build a fair, peaceful society and keep the earth safe for future generations). Stanza 5: we join together as many and diverse expressions of 'one loving mystery' — all people and creatures are part of one creation — for the healing of the earth and the renewal of all life.

Environmental protection; unity of humans and nature; collective responsibility; concern for future generations. The earth is home not only to humans but to all creatures. Devices: the refrain (repeated line) gives the poem the feel of a prayer or song; parallel phrases with 'To…' (to restore, to refresh, to renew…); free verse.

sa2: What should humans do to make the world a better place to live in?
They should join with the earth and each other to clean the land, water and air, renew forests, protect plants and creatures, and promote justice and peace.
What must we do if we want fresh air and water in the future?
We must stop polluting, restore the waters, refresh the air and renew the forests by working together to heal the earth.
What does the poet want us to do to water, air and plants?
To restore the waters, refresh the air and care for the plants.
What is the refrain in the poem and why is it used?
'We join with the earth and with each other.' It is repeated at the start of every stanza to stress unity and collective effort and to give the poem the rhythm of a prayer.
What does 'to remember our children' mean in the poem?
It means we must protect the earth for future generations so that our children inherit a healthy, peaceful world.
sa3: What is the central idea of 'A Prayer for Healing'?

The earth is our only home and we have harmed it. The poem is an appeal to all people to join together with the earth and with each other to clean the land, water and air, renew forests, protect creatures, enjoy nature's gifts and promote justice and peace, so that the earth is healed and all life renewed for our children.

or: Why is the poem called a 'prayer'?

Like a prayer it is said together by many people, with a repeated refrain and a humble, hopeful tone. It asks for the healing of the earth and the renewal of all life, and calls all people, as parts of 'one loving mystery', to work together.
